Study limits and identity

One painted side view with a joint-weighted mesh. This tests breathing, bracing and tail flexibility; walking, jaw articulation, unseen anatomy and native game integration remain unfinished. The unpainted residents are omitted from this review only. Their game identities remain unchanged.
